title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1971-04-29
lineage: Master Reel (Teac A-6100) -> Advent Advocate Dolby B Unit -> Fostex FR-2LE -> WAV (24bit/96k)  Mastering Info: WAV -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.03 -> FLAC/24
source: SBD -> Shure Line Mixers -> Advent Advocate Dolby B Unit -> Master Reel (Sony Deck - BASF Tapes - 1/4 Track - 7 1/2 ips)

ai_review.summary: Excellent Miller soundboard captures a solid ’71 show with standout Hard to Handle, Morning Dew and Me & My Uncle despite a mixed first set.
ai_review.review: The 24‑bit Miller soundboard source is praised for its clarity and completeness, though the older 16‑bit cut has a noticeable edit. Musically the concert sits just above average for the era – a strong second set highlighted by Hard to Handle, Morning Dew and the famed Me & My Uncle, while the first set runs a bit thin with some shaky encore material.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is rated around 3¼ stars (slightly above average) while the recording is described as excellent; weighted combination yields a ~3.8‑star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: 24‑bit Miller sbd is pitch‑accurate and clear; the older 16‑bit version has a cut, but the 24‑bit retains the full performance.

poor_songs: Bertha (not the best of the week)
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is uneven (B‑ grade) with solid jams but some weaker moments; second set is strong (C+ including encores, B+ without them) and runs over two hours ending in a triple encore.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Snarly tone on his first Alembic custom guitar noted on Bertha; possible steel‑sounding sitar on Dark Hollow; overall strong lead work.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass highlighted in It Hurts Me (great Pig) and the desire for more presence during Sugar Magnolia; solid foundation throughout.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals on Truckin' are praised (“Bobby gets ’em right”).
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums transition into a forward‑looking jam before GDT RFB, rated B+; overall tight and driving.
